DRAM_UP.text: TrendForce publishes a press release stating that conventional (non-HBM) DRAM contract prices are expected to rise, or did rise, by 5% or more quarter-over-quarter in 1Q27
DRAM_UP.resolution: Resolves YES if at least one press release published on the TrendForce press center (trendforce.com/presscenter) between 2026-12-01 and 2027-03-31 states that conventional DRAM contract prices (TrendForce's term for non-HBM DRAM) are expected to rise, or did rise, by 5% or more QoQ in 1Q27. A stated range counts only if its lower bound is at least 5% (e.g. '5-10% QoQ' counts; '3-8% QoQ' does not). Resolves NO if the stated 1Q27 change is below +5%, flat, or negative, or if no such press release appears by 2027-03-31. Baseline: TrendForce's 2026-07-03 press release forecast conventional DRAM contract prices to rise 13-18% QoQ in 3Q26 while warning that gains would moderate on weaker consumer demand and a high base.
DRAM_UP.source: TrendForce press center (trendforce.com/presscenter) quarterly memory contract price press release
